results: Actual high pairs on ANY two concentric free-centered discs align with the SAME endpoints and exact algebraic repetitions. Their intrinsic monic gap polynomials, midpoint and squared half-gap agree across radii, including a collapsed gap.

The actual filled squares vanish at a COMMON ACTUAL branch root by exact factorization. The verified squaredCosh inverse fixes equality near that root; the analytic identity theorem propagates it throughout the entire overlap of the original open discs. This holds for COMPLEX potentials and requires no realness or supplied square equality.

On the complement of the ACTUAL complex gap, filled-square equality and the same intrinsic polynomial give equality of normalized-root squares. Their proved near-one normalization fixes the sign. Density of the segment complement and continuity then identify the roots on the ENTIRE overlap, including the gap and its collapsed endpoint.

The ACTUAL analytic normalized ratio is independent of BOTH local square K and radius r. The shared semicircle formula along the COMMON ACTUAL segment proves equality, without division by the gap. Winding-one discriminant contour actions in different charts agree, even when the contours have different shapes and radii.

Actual analytic action neighborhoods are CONSTRUCTED from the verified high trace-square family, not postulated as arbitrary conjugacy/action data. One original OPEN COMPLEX H-minus-one neighborhood and cutoff precede every later index and every nearby complex potential, retaining the exact ratio error and nonvanishing.

For each original positive index n, hillHminusHighActionDomain is the OPEN UNION of all actual valid action neighborhoods. The chosen witness defines ONE glued ratio, gap square and action. They agree with EVERY valid neighborhood, so the values have no auxiliary-square/radius/contour dependence on that domain. All three are ANALYTIC there, including at collapsed gaps.

Every point of the open high-action domain has a genuine actual winding-one contour whose literal one-over-pi discriminant-over-root integral equals the glued action. On each valid neighborhood EVERY such contour equals the SAME glued action. The glued gap square equals the ACTUAL multiplicity-counted endpoint difference squared.

For EVERY native COMPLEX q and epsilon>0, ONE OPEN COMPLEX neighborhood V and ONE cutoff N satisfy V contained in EVERY later high-action domain, and norm(R_n-1)<=epsilon for ALL later n and ALL COMPLEX a in V. The SAME glued functions, independent of epsilon-dependent charts, satisfy the exact norm(8*pi*n*I_n-G_n)<=norm(G_n)*epsilon, with G_n the actual gap square.

Compactness of the ACTUAL gap segment improves each chart pointwise norm(S-1)<1 bound to one strict semicircle-mean bound. Therefore norm(R_n-1)<1 and R_n!=0 on the ENTIRE natural open high-action domain, not only inside a selected uniform-family neighborhood. The glued action vanishes IFF its actual gap square vanishes throughout that domain. Away from G_n=0 its literal normalized quotient8*pi*n*I_n/G_n is exactly the glued analytic ratio.

For every REAL native H-minus-one potential, one cutoff identifies the glued high gap square with (lambda_(2n)-lambda_(2n-1))^2 of the ACTUAL complete canonical label sequence, retaining the SAME positive original index. The proof uses actual pair uniqueness across the label and action radii, not only approximate localization.

Article-specific originalHighHillAction and originalHighHillActionRatio retain the ENTIRE original real mean-zero physically period-one H-minus-one distribution. With NO endpoint-membership assumption, all sufficiently high original indices satisfy I_n=gamma_n^2*R_n/(8*pi*n), norm(R_n-1)<=epsilon, norm(8*pi*n*I_n-gamma_n^2)<=norm(gamma_n)^2*epsilon, and I_n=0 IFF the original canonical gap gamma_n=0.

The functions are proved on their explicit PER-INDEX natural open high-action domains, with local eventual coverage of ALL complex potentials by ALL high indices. A common complex neighborhood of the full real source on which ALL indices give the ORIGINAL canonical actions, the remaining low-index construction and global Birkhoff-coordinate identification are NOT proved. Values defined as zero outside the natural high-action domains carry no canonical-action assertion. Full source3.2 and ALL FIVE MAIN theorems remain UNPROVED; goal ACTIVE.
